description: This file defines the LegendMapper class responsible for mapping Legend objects within chart objects in the MigraDoc rendering library. It includes methods to map legend properties based on their position in different chart areas.

classes.name: LegendMapper
classes.description: A class responsible for mapping Legend objects from DocumentObjectModel to Chart objects within the MigraDoc rendering process.

methods.name: MapObject
methods.description: Maps properties from a DocumentObjectModel chart to a Chart object, specifically handling the Legend based on its position in the chart areas.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Static method to create an instance of LegendMapper and invoke MapObject to perform the mapping.
